title: Google DeepMind just launched Lyria 3 Pro and Artlistio #ai #freeonlinetools #tech #creativecontent
description:
Google DeepMind just launched Lyria 3 Pro and Artlistio has integrated a refined version of it built on their professional production style The model generates up to threeminute tracks with professional audio but the huge improvement here is that it understands song structure It handles musical composition more explicitly so you can prompt specific verses choruses and bridges with smooth transitions between each song section But the key part about this model for creators and entrepreneurs is that whatever you create with it you own so you never have to worry about licensing structure google artlist lyria3 ai
Roberto Nickson
